newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - April 21.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - April 21.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following stories on its front page on Monday:
JERUSALEM - A divided prosecution team announced that it has dropped a criminal probe against Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.

GRAND FORKS, NORTH DAKOTA - Authorities have threatened to use National Guard troops to arrest residents of Grand Forks, North Dakota who are refusing to leave their homes, despite record flooding and huge fires.
CLEVELAND - The Washington Bullets won a spot in the National Basketball Association playoffs for the first time since 1988 by beating the Cleveland Cavaliers 85-81.
WASHINGTON - The long-troubled Benning Heights neighborhood of Washington is hoping a new peace among rival youths will last.
WASHINGTON - An increasing number of Christian-Jewish couples are honoring the traditions of both religions.
WASHINGTON - Madeleine Albright is the most media-savvy secretary of state since Henry Kissinger in the 1970s.

EAGLE, COLORADO - Military pilots searching for an attack jet that disappeared during a training mission in Arizona spotted piece of gray painted metal that they believe to be the plane's wreckage protruding from the snow near a Colorado mountain peak.
